fichas.title: Multi-Storey Industrial Buildings
fichas.summary: Multi-storey industrial buildings suit production processes in which materials are conveyed to the uppermost floor and then descend by gravity, as well as light industry. They are compact and space-saving, with good operating costs, simple ventilation and good side lighting, but are expensive and have limited floor loadings. The page discusses structural spans, room heights, column layouts, daylighting, window areas and floor-slab supports.
